description: <p><strong>FEATURES</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Best material:</strong> Our baby bodysuit is made of 100% combed ringspun cotton, soft and comortable. Heather is 88/12 combed ringspun cotton/polyester. CVC colors are 60/40 combed ringspun cotton/polyester. White is sewn with 100% cotton thread. Soft material feels great on your kids’ skin and very light. Total comfort from head to sweet little toes. Super soft stretch fabric fits baby longer.</li><li><strong>Perfect Design:</strong> 1x1 baby rib, flatlock stitched seams, double-needle stitched ribbed binding on neck, shoulders, sleeves and leg openings. Innovative three-snap closure, side seam construction. CPSIA compliant tracking label in side seam. Easy Tear™ label. Easy over head your baby. Moves with baby without pinching or binding.</li><li><strong>Customization:</strong> We make baby bodysuit on demand, so give us your favorite design to create your one-of-a-kind baby bodysuit.</li><li><strong>Gift of Love:</strong> It will be novelty and funny gift for babies in special occasions.</li><li><strong>Garment Care</strong>: Machine wash or hand wash. Tumble dry on low heat. Avoid direct heat. Do not use bleach.</li><li><strong>Brand:</strong> Infant Baby Bodysuit - 4400</li></ul><p> </p><p><strong>SPECIFICATION</strong><br> </p><ul><li><strong>Processing Time:</strong> 3 – 5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly</li><li><strong>Shipping Time: </strong>5 – 7 working days average (EU)</li><li><strong>Packaging: </strong>1x Baby Bodysuit</li><li> </li></ul><p><strong>PRODUCTION</strong></p><ul><li>Manufacturer: Made in EU</li><li>Tracking Country Origin is EU</li></ul><p><strong>NOTE:</strong></p><ul><li>Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.</li><li>Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.</li></ul>
guideLine: <p><strong>Print Guidelines</strong></p><p>Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups <a href="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zfoWsa1Y0cfmnryoVnhvGwjnKCevGOXZ">here</a></p><p><strong>To use an Art Template:</strong></p><ul><li>Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.</li><li>Insert your artwork in a new layer, <strong>placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template</strong> to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.</li><li>If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.</li><li>Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.</li><li>Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.</li><li>You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.<ul><li>Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.</li></ul></li></ul><p><strong>To ensure your design prints properly on each product:</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Fill the entire design template!</strong> The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.</li><li><i><strong>Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product. </strong></i></li></ul>
